column17: guess start & stop (stop: Acarnanian towns abandoned for Nicopolis -31, cf Stratos); inland town on road Stratos/Phytia-Limnaea near Katouna; Eurylochus' Spartan army crossed its territory -426 (Thuc 3.106); one of few interior towns independent of Aetolians after Alexander; Aetolians besiege it -231 for refusing to join their League, Medionians appeal to Demetrius II who hires Agron; 5000 Illyrians rout Aetolians (autumn) (Polyb 2.2-3) (NCAH VII_1.12 p 452) (CAH VII.23 p 748); taken by Antiochus III -191 (Livy 36.11-12)
